WITH watch_day AS (
      SELECT date,streamer_id,SUM(duration_seconds) watch_seconds FROM view_sessions
      WHERE date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY date,streamer_id
    ), w AS (
      SELECT 'all' dimension,SUM(v.duration_seconds)/3600.0 watch_duration_hours,COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id) viewer_uv
      FROM view_sessions v JOIN streamers s ON v.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
      WHERE v.date BETWEEN :start AND :end  GROUP BY dimension
    ), gifts AS (
      SELECT 'all' dimension,SUM(t.amount_idr) gift_amount_idr FROM transactions t JOIN streamers s ON t.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
      WHERE t.date BETWEEN :start AND :end  GROUP BY dimension
    ), live AS (
      SELECT 'all' dimension,SUM(b.live_seconds)/3600.0 live_duration_hours,
      SUM(CASE WHEN b.live_seconds>0 AND b.live_seconds>=:min_live AND COALESCE(wd.watch_seconds,0)>=:min_watch THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) effective_live_days
      FROM streamer_daily b JOIN streamers s ON b.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
      LEFT JOIN watch_day wd ON b.date=wd.date AND b.streamer_id=wd.streamer_id
      WHERE b.date BETWEEN :start AND :end  GROUP BY dimension
    ) SELECT live.dimension,COALESCE(gifts.gift_amount_idr,0) gift_amount_idr,
      COALESCE(w.watch_duration_hours,0) watch_duration_hours,live.effective_live_days,live.live_duration_hours,
      COALESCE(w.viewer_uv,0) viewer_uv FROM live LEFT JOIN w ON live.dimension=w.dimension
      LEFT JOIN gifts ON live.dimension=gifts.dimension ORDER BY live.dimension

effective_live_days.definition: 各主播达到有效开播门槛的主播日数之和；单主播查询为天数
effective_live_days.label: 有效直播天数

live_duration_hours.definition: 主播实际开播秒数合计/3600；与看播时长分开
live_duration_hours.label: 直播时长

viewer_uv.definition: 所选期间去重观看用户数，不累加每天UV
viewer_uv.label: 观看观众数

watch_duration_hours.definition: 观看会话时长合计/3600；观众累计观看小时
watch_duration_hours.label: 看播时长

metric_contract.note: 统一供周报、活动复盘与助推更新使用；阈值为可编辑Demo假设。

effective_live_day.note: Demo默认：单主播单日直播至少1小时，累计被观看至少30分钟；待替换为实际业务口径。

monitoring.note: 同长度上一窗口对比；下降至少20%且两期观看UV均不少于30时提醒；非统计检验。

traffic_boost.note: 仅生成待审核的助推更新建议；不是实际下发流量，也不是收益预测。
